items.summary: Argentina's Nucleoeléctrica says that testing of key equipment is under way as part of the verification process before the commissioning of the dry storage facility for used fuel, which is under construction for Atucha 2.

items.title: Ampera, LLNL team up for TRISO fuel development
items.summary: US microreactor developer Ampera Inc has announced a strategic partnership project with the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory to further the development of scalable, advanced nuclear fuel for use in advanced nuclear energy systems, including compact and subcritical reactor platforms.

items.title: Welding of Akkuyu 2's primary circuit completed
items.summary: The reactor, steam generators and reactor coolant pumps are all connected in the primary circuit of Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant's second unit, after the completion of the welding of the main coolant pipeline.
